hook_first_words: This is the all new MacBook Pro
first_frame: Technical Guruji standing next to a white pedestal with a MacBook Pro on it, with a large Apple logo on the wall behind him.
beats: 0-3 s: Hook and intro to the new MacBook Pro.
3-14 s: Technical specs (display, brightness, contrast, refresh rate).
14-18 s: Demonstration of the touchscreen functionality.
18-24 s: Port overview (Thunderbolt 5, HDMI, Headphone Jack, MagSafe, SDXC).
27-30 s: Pricing and model comparison graphic.
30-37 s: Showcase of the glowing Apple logo.
37-41 s: B-roll of the device in use.
captions: White text, 3-5 words per chunk, centered or lower third, no highlight colour.
sound: Direct speech, no background music, clear audio, no sound effects.
recurring_element: The Apple logo on the wall behind the presenter.
ending: Direct address to camera with a final opinion.
why: The video is a straightforward, dry recitation of specs without a strong narrative or engaging visual flow. The lack of background music makes it feel flat, and the rapid-fire delivery of technical details is overwhelming, failing to create a compelling reason for the viewer to watch until the end.
reusable_faceless: Dynamic text overlays synced to speech
Screen recording overlays to demonstrate software features
Static infographics for complex pricing/spec data
